deliverables: Allocate capital to builders expected to improve monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
Require funded projects to track core KPIs including monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
Continue KPI dashboard development toward live on-chain Cardano data tracking.
Use an independent administrator/multisig to validate milestone completion before the Cardano Builder DAO receives funds.
Return unused or unallocated funds to the Cardano Treasury.
request.recipient: Cardano Builder DAO, with funds administered by an independent dRep DAO council/multisig before milestone-based disbursement.
request.what: Fund the Cardano Builder DAO as an ecosystem-wide, smart contract-governed funding mechanism for projects intended to advance Cardano Vision 2030 KPIs.

claims.claim: The Cardano Builder DAO is presented as a smart contract-governed funding mechanism for builders that can advance Cardano Vision 2030 KPIs including MAU, monthly transactions, and TVL.
The proposal says funded projects will be required to track monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
The DAO built Version 1 and Version 2 of a KPI dashboard, with Version 2 moving toward KPI tracking tied directly to live on-chain Cardano data.
The Cardano Builder DAO has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.

Round 1 reportedly included 38 voting members, 27 requesting members, 20 funded companies, 83% governance participation, and 5,541,335 ADA distributed through a transparent smart contract-governed process.
Round 2 reportedly added 18 new members, funded 14 companies, and achieved 88% member participation after review, debate, temperature checks, and final voting.

The proposal asserts that the DAO has created and amended governing documents, elected a board, added third-party assurance, implemented merit-based proposal review, and executed on-chain treasury withdrawals transparently.
The administrator will be an independent council of dRep DAO members, currently naming Cardano Yoda and Marco Grendel Moshi with one additional non-affiliated active dRep to be added.
The proposal states that administrator-held ADA will be kept in separate auditable accounts, not delegated to any stake pool operator, and delegated to the predefined abstain voting option.
The proposal states that the Cardano Builder DAO returned 354,790 ADA of unused funds to the treasury after its first two governance rounds and provides an AdaStat transaction link.

summary: The document requests 20,000,000 ADA for the Cardano Builder DAO to continue and expand a smart contract-governed, KPI-oriented funding mechanism for Cardano builders, citing prior funding rounds, governance participation, KPI tracking, independent administration, milestone disbursement, and unused-fund repayment commitments.
